title: Mobile Suit Victory Gundam
description: Uso Ewin gets himself tangled in a battle between the Yellow Jacket and guerrilla resistance League Militaire. Following his heart, Uso pilots the resistance's mobile suit and goes against the Zanscare Empire of space.

title: W
description: Katie Lewis and her husband Ben discover that they are the targets of a mysterious killer who leaves the letter W at the scene of their near-fatal "accidents." While trying to avoid death, the couple must struggle to discover the source of these attacks.

title: W
description:
W - If Woman is one of the words which comes to your mind, this movie is for you!

Open-minded, ambitious Sandhya Singh a.k.a Sandy (Leeza Mangaldas); Traditional, romantic Roohi Malik (Lezlie Tripathy) and Rebellious, lesbian (gay) Manu (Sonal Giani) are musicians & best friends forever (BFF) who run an event management company called W.

Short of funds and racing against time on their journey to organize their biggest music event yet The Freedom Concert they unexpectedly encounter The introvert, fanatic Abhay a.k,a. Bhaiji (Raaj Singh Arora); Mentally unstable Dhruv (Danish Pandor) & Womanizer Chotu (Abhay Attri). Although of good social standing, these men have issues with urbanization & modernity!

Not a battle of fists, W comes as a contemporary youthful musical thriller which explores the clash between the Women of Today and Men of Yesterday and how each side justifies their actions, words and mindset while setting an example for the rest of us without being preachy.

title: W zawieszeniu
description: Marcel is a Polish resistance fighter sentenced to death by communist authorities. When he escapes from prison, the only person he can stay at is Anna, his wartime lover.

title: Sweet Games
description: The campus belle An Ran pretended to be a "winner" to gain investment, but she was exposed in front of other people. She got drunk and accidentally had a one-night love with her younger landlord Yan Yue.

title: Skapani w ogniu
description: The first days in the so-called Recovered Lands abound in conflicts between the local Silesians and the immigrants. Former resistance fighter Captain Sowinski tries hard to reduce the tensions.

title: Ana w Hoa w Hya
description: The play revolves around Hamdi, a lawyer, who falls in love with a Nadia who he meets during a trip to Fayoum. However, due to a misunderstanding, he believes she is the wife of a thug who is searching for her and vowing to kill her. The events escalate through a series of comical situations.

title: Aarous w Aaris
description: As he looks for a suitable bride, Nassim returns to Lebanon where he enlists the help of matchmaking service. But he finds himself falling for Noura, the service's manager.

title: iGirlfriend
description: A teen comedy about a nerdy teenager who creates an iPhone app to be his girlfriend. When she miraculously comes to life, things go hilariously wrong, and she tries to kill him.

title: Saber w Rady
description: As the paralyzed businessman named Rady decides to hire a caretaker to look after him, Saber applies for the job, and they get into many comedic situations.

title: W spirali
description: An out of town car trip, which was meant to have a purifying effect on the trouble-stricken married couple, turns into a dangerous interaction between characters when they pick up an eccentric traveler, Tamir. Tamir is a witness to, and a catalyst of their problems, a self-appointed healer wishing to become their path to enlightenment. Krzysztof and Agnes know they shouldn't be together but they are unable to part, or perhaps they do not want to? "Into the Spiral" is a story of love which is restless, dangerous and toxic.

title: Ana w Hiyya W Haya
description: Ana w Hiyya W Haya

title: W cieniu nienawisci
description: In 1943, Ewa decides to take care of her Jewish neighbour's daughter and brings her home just for a few days. When the ghetto uprising begins, the woman keeps on looking after the little girl.

title: Confusion and Jealousy (Heere w Gheere)
description: Amal is torn apart between following her dream to become an actress and continue her studies, and between the guy she likes, Sam, and the one who truly loves her, Jad.

title: Helwe W Kezzebe: Beautiful Liar
description: Dalida, a pretty girl from a working class family who constantly lies about her background. She and Ramzy, a famous singer fall in love, but her lies catch up to her.

title: Koulha W Teriqou
description: During the eighties in Morocco and exactly in Rabat, the well-known carpet merchant Mamoun lives an ordinary life with his large family, until the day the family finds itself amid serious difficulties and conflicts, and the lives of its members are turned upside down, so that Mamoun faces a set of challenges to save his family as the head of the family.

title: Max w Antar
description: Max lives in the United States, he loses all his money. He then returns to Lebanon, with his spoiled dog, and works as a security officer. He and his dog are placed in a situation where they need to rescue Nadia's kidnapped father.

title: Qesma w Naseeb
description: A reality TV show hosted by the star Rita Harb that gathers young men and women from different Arab countries on a secluded island in Turkey with the goal of finding true love.

title: Forest Bathing: Friends W/Benefits
description: Eccentric woman leads guided meditations virtually through forest while sexting with her friend and dealing with her inner demons.

title: W bialy dzien
description: Set in 1905. The story focuses on a young and inexperienced man in a revolutionary execution squad. He does his killing job out of idealism, and for the love of a woman. The young student murders a Russian spy and is afterwards arrested by the police. Much to his surprise he is released after a session with the traitor-judge, hinting at some leaks in the organization. Student reports his suspicions back to the organization, but in response is given a new hit mission, aimed at a Polish writer believed to be collaborating with the Russians. The killer comes to Cracow where the writer lives and comes to a conclusion that perhaps the writer is innocent, since there is no conclusive evidence.

title: Chaser Game W 2: Beautiful Celestial Goddesses
description: Reunited lovers Itsuki and Fuyu navigate familial disapproval and the reappearance of Fuyu's first love, straining their rekindled relationship after years apart. Despite overcoming initial obstacles, new trials test their commitment.

title: Mr. X, a Vision of Leos Carax
description: The image of a mysterious, solitary filmmaker - a cineaste maudit - who flees from both the media and the public, is unrelentingly bound to the figure of Leos Carax, in France. Elsewhere, the real focus is on his films and he is considered to be an icon of world cinema. Mr.X dives into the poetic and visionary world of an artist who was already a cult figure from his very first film. Punctuated by interviews and unseen footage, this documentary is most of all a fine-tuned exploration of the poetic and visionary world of Leos Carax, alias "Mr.X".

title: Emmanuelle y Carol
description: After Emmanuelle, a clothing designer, catches her husband Mario with another man, she leaves him for Carol, one of her female employees.

title: Moros y cristianos
description: A peculiar family who owns a nougat factory decides to set out on a trip to Madrid to advertise their products in a Food Fair. Besides the disapproval from the family head and company founder, events are not as expected.

title: Platero y yo
description: After a long period of absence, living in large and anonymous cities, a poet, Juan, returns to the village of his birth, Moguer, there he finds happiness through; the friendship of a small donkey, Platero, a free spirited girl, Aguedilla, and recalling memories of his childhood.

title: Y abrázame
description: During the first date of Joaco and Josefina, she disappears leaving only a trail of blood. Joaco will travel the city looking for the answer to his bloody problem.

title: ¿Y si sí...?
description: Imitators, comedy actors, monologists, and even YouTubers and influencers are put together for numerous comedy sketches about common themes of all sorts.

title: Esquivar y pegar
description: Benito Eufemia has spent 9 years in prison. Now he's waiting for his last boxing match.

title: Pan y Circo
description: Conversations unite experts and different personalities to touch fundamental topics of universal interest in contemporary societies, accompanied by the menus of well-known Mexican chefs.

title: Romeo y Julieta
description: Two teenagers fall in love, but their feuding families and fate itself cause the relationship to end in tragedy.

title: Balas y Katanas
description: How would you react if you were a Martial Arts expert, had a Katana in your hands, and your daughter had just been kidnapped. Under this premise, Sensei Marín launches a race against time with Nacho, his best friend.

title: Naranja y media
description: Juan Guerrero has problems with his partner so they distance themselves, at that time he meets Ángeles 'Lali' Zabala and falls in love with her. Nothing is ever simple with Juan, so when he and his wife make up, he can't decide between her and Lali. From there, more characters complicate these entanglements: Juan's friends and relatives, former partners of his lovers, Juan's doppelganger named Santiago Gariboti and a kidnapper dressed in a Santa suit.

title: García y García
description: Two men with the same name endure the funny consequences of getting mixed up during a business trip.

title: 40 y tantos
description: Comedy focusing on the mid-life crises of three siblings.

title: Enrique y Judita
description: For Enrique and Judita dancing tango means living their dream. They were tango Vice World Champions in Buenos Aires in 2003. Their artistic development in tango is inextricably linked with their love for one another. Everyday, tango challenges them anew to face the truth. This movie is dedicated to their fight for honesty in art and love.

title: Sexo y revolución
description: In the early 1970s, Argentine homosexuals were arrested and tortured by the police or in institutions for the mentally ill.

title: Saber y ganar
description: Quiz show in which the contestants have to answer about general knowledge.

title: El y Ella
description: Talk show with male ("El") and Female ("Ella") co-hosts who explore problems that affect average couples and individuals.

title: Gen Y
description: Mark wants to challenge Dr. Kit from Faculty of Medicine. He keeps pursuing the doctor and when he has the confidence to ask Kit to be his boyfriend, something happens at the same time and as a result, Kit does not accept Mark's love.

title: Prep Z
description: A reluctant zombie prepper must take charge and fight off a self proclaimed survivalist to reunite his team of misfits who may or may not have lost patient zero.

title: Z mého zivota
description: A musical biography of Czech composer Bedrich Smetana.From My Life, which is the English translation of the title, is also the name given to his String Quartet No.1.

title: Indiáni z Vetrova
description: In the frontier village Vetrov boys from the children's home called Indians lead a bitter "war" with the local Símáks. Before a battle the Indians have a meeting in the sandpit with a smoke signaling. The smoke brings to the sandpit a frontier guard Tomás with a police dog Ranek. The children learn from Tomás that Rank served out and that it shall be destroyed. The nine-year old Fanda writes a letter to the "minister of the frontier guards" in which he asks to let Ranek live. To save Ranek's life he also visits the local frontier guard commander. In the end it is decided that children from the children's home may keep Ranek.

title: Mazinger Z [English]
description: Teenager Koji Kabuto pilots the amazing super-robot Mazinger Z to avenge its inventor (his grandfather) against the Mycene Empire, led by the evil mad scientist Doctor Hell.

title: Pozegnanie z Maria
description: Jewish girl escapes from Ghetto and enters the world of Poles revealing various life attitudes... The dramatic story of human fate, feelings, and passions, which takes place during a period of contempt for all normal values. Love, hate, fear and death, and by their side people's normal existence, filled with compromises, illegal business dealings during the war years. The picture that not only shows in full the system by which people are destroyed, but its results for the human psyche and moral values. It fully exptains how the mechanisms of change are introduced into people, the personal philosophy adopted in order to survive, the neighboring borders between good and evil.

title: 75-0: The Documentary
description: This is a story about winning and losing in youth sports and the lasting effects it had on a group of players who played on one of the worst high school football teams in New Jersey history. Centering around one game that this team lost 75-0 we learn about their pain and agony they still feel even after 46 years! Through interviews with ex-players, experts on sports psychology, and game footage we explore the reasons how losing became a habit and more importantly how they transformed it into one of life's great lessons .

description: Vivaldi's The Four Seasons and four outstanding violinists are the threads the filmmakers use to weave this exploration of how nature shapes who we are. As Spring reaches Toyko and the cherry blossoms burst to life, violinist Sayaka Shoji demonstrates to her young students the timeless lessons in the music, and in their own culture. Niki Vasilakis and friends travel from all corners of Australia to the Far North to share the music of Summer with the Thursday Island Community, as the monsoon clouds gather. As the leaves turn, Cho-Liang (Jimmy) Lin and his neighbours reveal to us their New York City's vibrant, complex personality. Finally, in the icy reaches of Finnish Lapland, Pekka Kuusisto and his colleagues bring the warmth of music and human interaction to the small local community. A documentary full of fascinating characters, fine music and glorious images as it reflects on the global experience of the seasons.

description: Bigg Boss Kannada is a reality show based on the Hindi show Bigg Boss which too was based on the original Dutch Big Brother. Each week, housemates nominate two of their fellow housemates for eviction, and the housemates who receives the most nominations would face a public vote. title: Byomkesh Bakshi [Bengali]
description: It is 1964. The Sino Indian war is over. Opium is seeping into the city through invisible cracks and crime is on the rise. A few streets around Chinapara, Kolkata, have earned a reputation for notoriety. And it doesn't take long before a murder takes place on a street near a hostel for men at the fringe of the locality. It is during this time that an oddly curious young man by the name of Atul Mitra arrives at the hostel looking for a place to stay. He is reluctantly allowed to lodge with the help of Ajit, a young struggling writer. Soon after another murder takes place and this time it is a resident of the hostel.The story unfolds through the eyes of Ajit, as Atul solves the mystery of drug trade and the murders one straw at a time. Atul is none other than the legendary fictional sleuth, Byomkesh Bakshi. A few years after this case is solved another strange murder takes place at a mansion at the heart of the city. The victim is Karalibabu, a wealthy contractor and a childless widower. The murder weapon is a stitching needle pierced into his spinal cord just below the medulla oblongata. Byomkesh is called upon to investigate the case. The nephews and nieces of Karalibabu, living in the mansion, are all probable suspects. The victim had attracted resentment from quite a few of them with his rude remarks and by frequently excluding them from his will after an altercation.

description:
Aditya Choudhury (Tapas Paul) is a faction leader in Kurnool who raised his sister Saraswati (Laboni Sarkar) with love and affection to make her forget the loss of their mother. During the marriage time, she eloped with Mohsin Khan (Rajatava Dutta), whom she loved which led the death Aditya Choudhury's father. Thus enraged Aditya cuts the leg of Mohsin which created a rift between the two families. On a case to win the property belonging to Saraswati, Mohsin wins the case on Aditya Choudhury after a long gap of 25 years. Seeing the sorrow of Saraswati, her son Sulaiman (Ankush Hazra) vows to unite the two families and waits for a situation.

Meanwhile, on a suggestion by Pulok Purohit (Kanchan Mullick), Aditya Choudhury appoints his manager Dayashankar Bal (Kharaj Mukherjee) to find a great scholar to perform a "Shanti Yogga". The boy named Krishna, in a fit of rage (as his love interest Aparna is close to Michael because of Sulaiman), shows Sulaiman to Dayashankar and tells him that he is Krishna Bhattacharya but prefers to be called as Sulaiman. Though initially he refuses to accept, Sulaiman accepts that he is Krishna Bhattacharya as this would be a Golden Chance to unite the two families. He, along with his friend Michael (Partho Sarathi Chakraborty) and a group of Bramhins (played by Lama, Aritra Dutta Banik, Bhola Tamang and others) goes to the palace of Aditya Choudhury.

There he manages to act well, only to be noticed by Puja (Nusrat Jahan), the adopted daughter of Aditya Choudhury. Though she tries to make his true colours screened (i.e. he is not a Scholar), he escapes by his wit and timing. In an unexpected situation, Dayashankar visits Krishna's home to pay his father but shockingly he finds out the truth that Sulaiman is acting as Krishna Bhattacharya. Having a fear of getting murdered by Aditya Choudhury, he discloses the facts and wants the "yogga" to be completed as soon as possible. Sulaiman, though interested in Puja, finds his mother's wish much important and starts playing various plans to intimate feelings on Saraswati in Aditya's heart but all go vain. description: The road ahead might be straight and even, but human character is shaped by the journey thereon. Sagar and his father set out to invite their far-off relatives to Sagar's wedding. "Farmers are not good suitors", yet somehow Sagar has found a bride and they are about to be married. Sagar and his father are always at odds against each other for no particular reason. description: The story of Han Li, a poor and ordinary boy from a village. In order to let his family lead a better life, he willingly heads to Qi Xuan Sect to take their entrance exam. He was accepted by Mo Da Fu, and begins his journey in jianghu.

title: Sniper
description: The Tiger Security Team of the Storm Security Company is responsible for security and rescue work. Luo Xinglie is punished for accidentally injuring a hostage during a rescue mission. He gets reduced to a security officer and gets no reward for the mission. At this time, the Tiger Team receives a new mission, hired by the International Peace Foundation, to escort a truck full of water purifiers and a large number of crop seeds to the villages of Sakiya for civilian assistance. However, due to the invasion of the non-government organization in Sakya, some areas are in war. The team is likely to encounter fighting, and the unknown danger is gradually approaching.

title: Holy Hierarchy: The Religious Roots of Racism in America
description: Holy Hierarchy explains how the belief in a Supreme Being in colonial Virginia led to notions of supreme human beings and how these notions morphed their way into the legal system; ultimately creating racism and turning it into an racism into institution.

title: Til Debt Do U$ Part
description: Money can't buy you love. But keeping love alive without money can be pretty tough. In fact, ninety percent of marriage breakups are due to money problems. And to get advice on how to manage money usually costs money! Til Debt Do Us Part, is a series that offers tough-love solutions to those willing to face their financial troubles head on. In each episode we meet a couple in crisis. Some are on the verge of bankruptcy, hounded by creditors or facing eviction. Others are just getting by, but in the midst of a personal meltdown or relationship breakdown because of money issues. With the sensitivity of a therapist and the toughness of a CFO, our host, renowned financial author and columnist, Gail Vaz-Oxlade reveals what she's found in a couple's finances - and then she'll dig a little deeper. She asks some tough questions and then they'll be forced to face reality. Where will it end if they continue on this rocky road? To get things back on track, Gail takes control of their finances for one month. She devises a strict budget and enforces some dramatic changes. A two-car family may become a one-car; or no-car family. The new hair salon may become the corner barbershop and goodbye fancy lattes - hello thermos. All credit cards and debit cards are taken away and their only discretionary cash is a weekly allowance. Gail makes regular house calls to deliver the week's allowance and assigns a new challenge for the couple to make them confront bad money habits and to help get their relationship back on track. At the end of the month, we find out how well they've done - how much did they save, what did they learn about money, themselves and each other? What is the new forecast for their finances and relationship? Gail can reward them with cash based on how well they did on their challenges. In addition, she always surprises them with a small but thoughtful gift, certain to generate hugs and the occasional tear. Til Debt Do Us Part is a dramatic and fun series that shows how bad it can get and how to get out from under.

title: Shion's King
description: As a child, Shion Ishiwatari's parents were murdered in their own home. Shion escaped unharmed, yet the trauma caused her to lose her voice. The only evidence police found was a shougi board and one piece "the King". Neighbours and close friends of the family, Shinji and Sachiko Yasuoka, adopted Shion and taught Shion how to play shougi. As the years passed, she became known as a genius and quite a famous player. Now, as her fame rises, her past resurfaces and she discovers that being a professional shogi player may just lead to finding her parents' killer.

title: King Corn
description: King Corn is a feature documentary about two friends, one acre of corn, and the subsidized crop that drives our fast-food nation. In King Corn, Ian Cheney and Curt Ellis, best friends from college on the east coast, move to the heartland to learn where their food comes from. With the help of friendly neighbors, genetically modified seeds, and powerful herbicides, they plant and grow a bumper crop of America's most-productive, most-subsidized grain on one acre of Iowa soil. But when they try to follow their pile of corn into the food system, what they find raises troubling questions about how we eat-and how we farm

title: IBCSR: The Institute for the Bio-Cultural Study of Religion
description: A 52-minute documentary about the Institute for the Bio-Cultural Study of Religion in Boston Massachusetts, where the scholars are neuroscientists, computer programmers, evolutionary biologists, cognitive psychologists, sociologists and anthropologists--who work alongside philosophers, ethicists, theologians, historians and linguists. The scientific study of religion is explored through scenes in research labs, interviews with research scientists, explorations of the Boston University campus and surrounding city, and glimpses into religious communities in various locations. Overviews of projects within the Institute are woven with a general discussion about how scientists explore, understand, and explain religious communities and behavior. What are the sensitivities of interdisciplinary research; the complexity of "religion" as a study object; dialogues between religion and science; the limits of science; and the value of scientific approaches to religion.

title: Life After BOB: The Chalice Study
description: Ian Cheng's Life After BOB is an episodic anime series built in the Unity game engine and presented live in real-time. Bridging the artist's interest in simulation's capacity to generate emergent surprising phenomena, with cinematic storytelling's capacity to evoke deep psychological truths, Life After BOB imagines a future world in which our minds are co-inhabited by AI entities. Life After BOB asks: How will life lived with AI transform the archetypal scripts that guide our sense of a meaningful existence? In episode one - The Chalice Study - neural engineer Dr. Wong has installed an experimental AI named BOB ("Bag of Beliefs") into the nervous system of his 10-year-old daughter Chalice. Designed to guide Chalice through the challenges of growing up in a volatile world, BOB confronts more and more of the conflicts in Chalice's life on her behalf, while Chalice grows increasingly irrelevant and escapist. As Dr. Wong begins to favor the BOB side of his daughter, and as BOB threatens to do the job of living Chalice's life better than she can, Chalice jealously wonders: what is left for her classic human self to do?

Children are placed on an exam stage where they risk falling behind in life if they do not complete the CSAT safely. To obtain the "score" that will determine their future, a survival CSAT war unfolds thrillingly with betrayals and tricks everywhere. It is expected to expose the dark side of entrance exams unflinchingly through the "unfair" children who search for the correct answer amid extreme dilemmas.

On the occasion of her fifth wedding anniversary, however, her seemingly perfect and happy life crumbled. Not only did her marriage to her "model" husband begin to unravel, but she also faced numerous crises, including being exploited and financially drained by her in-laws. With the help of her friends, Meng Yu reevaluated her life and took back control of her destiny.

description: Ivy endured years as a quiet, devoted wife, only to be brutally betrayed and thrown into a blizzard by her arrogant ex. Passion ignites as Aiden ruthlessly shields her from her toxic ex and empowers her to finally stand on her own. When her ex regrets his mistake and comes crawling back, Ivy has already moved on—and her new husband? A lethal predator her ex can never even dream of touching...

description:
Are you looking for some songs to sing with your child? Check out these Lingokids songs for kids and nursery rhymes! 

You can grab some snacks and spend a fun afternoon of quality family time while singing and dancing. 

Plus, with these children's songs in English, your little one will be able to practice vocabulary, learn prepositions, know more about action verbs, and improve many more skills that will be helpful for their future lives.

We're going on a Bear Hunt
Bingo the Dog
Itsy Bitsy Spider
Old MacDonald Had a Farm

... and more!

title: Programming in Python
description:
In this course, you will be introduced to foundational programming skills with basic Python Syntax. You’ll learn how to use code to solve problems. You’ll dive deep into the Python ecosystem and learn popular modules, libraries and tools for Python. 
You’ll also get hands-on with objects, classes and methods in Python, and utilize variables, data types, control flow and loops, functions and data structures. You’ll learn how to recognize and handle errors and you’ll write unit tests for your Python code and practice test-driven development.
By the end of this course, you will be able to:
•	Prepare your computer system for Python programming
•	Show understanding of Python syntax and how to control the flow of code
•	Demonstrate knowledge of how to handle errors and exceptions
•	Explain object-oriented programming and the major concepts associated with it
•	Explain the importance of testing in Python, and when to apply particular methods
This is a beginner course for learners who would like to prepare themselves for a career in back-end development or database engineering. To succeed in this course, you do not need prior web development experience, only basic internet navigation skills and an eagerness to get started with coding.

title: Excel Skills for Business: Advanced
description:
This advanced Excel course is designed for business professionals, data analysts, and financial analysts seeking to master complex spreadsheet software for data-driven decision-making. Building on foundational Excel skills, this program will transform you into a power user, enhancing your employability and positioning you ahead in a rapidly evolving digital job market. (Source: World Economic Forum 2023 Future of Jobs Report).
By the end of this course, you will be able to:
- Master advanced Excel formulas and lookup functions for efficient data handling.
- Clean and prepare complex data for robust analysis using Microsoft Excel.
- Apply financial functions and date formulas for business calculations and reporting.
- Design and build professional, interactive dashboards in Excel for business intelligence.
To be successful, you should have completed the Excel Skills for Business: Essentials, Intermediate I, and Intermediate II courses, or possess equivalent intermediate Microsoft Excel proficiency.
